loadMesh_bttn.what: Sets the selected mesh as the main mesh the variants work on.
examples: Select the body mesh and click <<.
Load the head mesh to manage hair variants on it.

break_connections_btn.what: Removes the set driven keys that control the variants visibility.
examples: Click it before changing the variants by hand.
Break them to key the variants by hand for a shot.
break_connections_btn.details: variant_manager.break_sdk_viz_connections(): disconnects the set driven key curves on the variant visibilities.

reloadUdims_bttn.what: Reloads the UDIM textures of the variants.
examples: Click it after the textures were updated on disk.
Reload after the texture artist published new maps.

openHpShade_bttn.what: Opens Maya's Hypershade to check the variant materials.
examples: Click it to see which material each variant uses.
Check the variant shaders are connected.
